_doc: NAV testbed config for the shared meta-harness (AutoSpatial/harness_map). Declares the task-specific Fitness mapping; the snake testbed has its own meta_config.json.

fitness._primary_note: was SR; SR is floored at 0 on the hard split so the variance-split (archive.cell_range reads fit.primary) could never fire. SubtaskSR is the non-degenerate primary. SR remains in dense/val_guard. leap.sr_field/val_guard reference 'primary' — review if those opt-in modes are activated.

leap._climb_doc: climb_field was dense.distance_progress, the most over-traversal-gameable signal (rewards covering forward distance without committing -> pinned the elite to the over-traversing anchor in skills_v5). Switched to dense.progress_score (empirically de-ranks the anchor: 0.689 < iter5 0.767). commit_gate makes the BINDING-leg pass rate (per_position_SR[binding] = the true, un-gameable commit signal) the TOP climb key: on skills_v5 the actionable MOVE_ALONG_ROAD leg runs 0.30-0.55, so commit_gate actively prefers the most-committing candidate within the SubtaskSR cap, with progress_score as the tiebreaker; it degrades to a no-op (progress_score decides) only when the binding leg is fully starved (e.g. a terminal leg pinned at 0).

val_guard._doc: Generalization guard (VAL_GUARD=1): an SR>0 crossing on search triggers a held-out probe; flatten only at sufficient power (false_flatten_p=(1-search_SR)^val_n <= alpha), else 'underpowered' escalates to a 2nd probe. probe_subset SHOULD be disjoint from the final/reported val subset so paper numbers stay unprobed (<=1 bit leaks per probed candidate); null falls back to the chain val subset until a split is chosen.
